## CELL FACTS

Cell 金_金. Core element Metal, energy element Metal. Law: Metal and Metal are the same element (the self pair). Relative to the core the energy is the self, so Metal is this core's Body.
- Family personas and ruled domains (the cost domain: the cost is named in these words or in ordinary life, work only where a domain word is work; the definition names one drive per persona, E8): The Twin: Peers, Independence, Self-reliance · The Rival: Rivalry, Shared stakes, Boldness

The classical excess idiom for this cell (say it in English in carry.excess, never quote it): 强金得水，方挫其锋 (强而得制, the self pair).
The eight wide openers (a carry.wide clause opens with one; no core repeats one across its wanted energies): "{Element} is one thing you never run short of" · "{Element} is easy for you to reach" · "{Element} is all around you" · "You have plenty of {Element}" · "{Element} is already here in plenty" · "You are well supplied with {Element}" · "You were given plenty of {Element}" · "There is no shortage of {Element} in you".
Fields shown above that are not the target are context for the repetition law (no four-word run shared with them) and for the cut law; do not rewrite them.

No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Metal core, so no percentage, no band and no state of one chart appears in any value (the engine owns the numbers). The pole's band facts come from the pair law and the band table (REA_02 §5c): the catalyst pole of Metal as the Body is the Underfueled band's case (the core burns more than it takes in), remedy verb Refill; the friction pole of Metal as the Body is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels), remedy verb Channel, cure set Fire (the taming cure by the ten equations, template-level). The states this cell renders (chart.mjs, journeyData.js: the pole's turn, or the carry line for an absent, thin, abundant, dominant or unrooted energy): catalyst_turn, friction_turn, unrooted, excess, thin. The yin sibling's overrides (mechanism_yin, carry_yin) are not in this batch and keep the station's text.

spec.construct: THE THREE BEATS (owner 2026-10-14, D14, function first). Beat 1, the first sentence, is this function's fixed sentence, word for word: "Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on." (the function for anyone; the gate blocks any other first sentence). Beat 2, one sentence: what Metal makes of your Body, Metal as the agent with its plain verb or state (E7), ending on what that does to the function for this reader; no amount of Metal, no pole. Beat 3, one or two sentences opening on "Running thin,": what the shortfall does to the function, then the family's two drives as one either-or (the tension sentence, D9, both personas inside it, E8), the cost as the close (D11, the reader its subject). NEVER an amount of the element anywhere in the definition ("more Earth than", "little Water", "Metal to spare", "runs thin": the gate blocks them; the bars will carry the amount); never the old opener "{Element} is your {Function}, and as a …" (the title line above the definition already says it). Three or four sentences, 30 to 50 words.
spec.chemistry: the field carries one word of the pair's chemistry anywhere in it as the energy's plain verb or state, or the energy's name in the mechanism sentence ("There is more Metal in you than you use"): Metal's or Metal's (flows, pours, settles; grows, builds, reaches; warm, light, fuel; holds, shelters, steady; hard, exact, finishes), or the body's own material (sleep, food, recovery, stamina, muscle, breath, rest); never a prop (blade, edge, ore, forge, cut, mountain, branch, root, stream, flame, heat, burn are blocked and do not count); the element's name in the opener does not count; the gate blocks without it (owner 2026-09-30, narrowed 2026-10-14)
spec.opener: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on.
spec.tension: one tension sentence: two of the reader's own acts or wants joined by or or while, a comparison hinge (rather than, instead of, ahead of, as much as, more than, better than), or whether … or not, in the plainest words on the page (the gate blocks a definition without it)
spec.notes: the family's two drives in one either-or, one clause per persona with its cost, anchored in that persona's ruled domain words, in two or three sentences (no inventory, owner 2026-10-14, polish rule 4); the mechanism sentence is required in a definition and names Metal and its volume in ordinary words. The v0.7.1 register (owner 2026-10-14, the seven blind rewrite iterations): the reader is the subject of every sentence and a third party only the object, the mechanism the reader's own need and never an external pressure (a third-person subject is noted, and blocked on the last sentence); the sentences progress on causal joints (because, so, since, which is why, which puts, whenever, until, over time, each time) and never turn (but, yet, however, the difficulty is, and then are blocked); no sentence over two commas (blocked); the last sentence is the line the reader keeps, at least eight words (blocked under), never a tag, an image or a line that exists to be quoted; no arena word (blade, edge, ore, forge, cut, mountain, steel, sword, sheath, knife, whetstone, mine, sharp, branch, orchard, prune, root, stream, river, flood, flame, heat, burn: blocked); the therapist winding down a session could say every sentence.

spec.remedy_gloss: Refill: intake, rest, taking in (read, sit, sleep, ask, wait for the whole answer); never a push for more output (the band's remedy verb, REA_02 §5c; no chart is attached: the catalyst pole of the Body is the Underfueled band's case (the core burns more than it takes in))
spec.notes: one plain truth sentence with the reader as its subject naming the psychological truth under the state, every action in the remedy verb's shape, then small actions with objects and cadences from the family's ruled domains or ordinary life (work only where a domain word is work), three or four, ending on the smallest, no aphorism close; no metaphor stacking; no prescription of investments, careers or medical acts; never a guarantee

spec.remedy_gloss: Channel: an outlet, an action that spends the excess (make, ship, say, lift, walk, cut); never a brake (the band's remedy verb, REA_02 §5c; no chart is attached: the friction pole of the Body is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels))

Let it {spend / hold / shape} what {the overgrown element} {stores / pours / burns}." The energy is the subject, a material the reader can hold and use, no life action inside the beat; the element must be in cure_set, never one that feeds this friction; the gate blocks without the "Seek {Element}, the {Function} energy" form; no metaphor stacking; no prescription of investments, careers or medical acts; never a guarantee
